thread:
frank: Quick sync / relnotes: I noticed the "canary" rollout note might confuse customers. We should clarify who sees fallback routing changes.

maya: Good catch. I updated wording to: 'Canary customers with rollout flag enabled will see fallback routing policies applied. General availability follows the full rollout schedule.'

toni: Also recommend adding a short example policy snippet so teams can verify behavior.

frank: Added this policy sample in the PR description:

    route: /v1/generate
    policy:
      prefer: low_latency
      fallback: cost_saver


maya: Looks good. Merging after final review.
